breakdown_revision_target.name: breakdown_revision_target
breakdown_revision_target.value: (entry_id IS NOT NULL AND history_row_id IS NULL) OR (entry_id IS NULL AND history_row_id IS NOT NULL)

transfer_accounts.name: transfer_accounts
transfer_accounts.value:
("entries"."kind" IN ('income','expense') AND "entries"."target_account_id" IS NULL AND "entries"."target_currency" IS NULL AND "entries"."target_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "entries"."exchange_rate" IS NULL AND "entries"."exchange_quote_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("entries"."kind" = 'transfer' AND "entries"."target_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."target_account_id" <> "entries"."account_id" AND "entries"."target_currency" = "entries"."currency" AND "entries"."target_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."target_amount_minor" = "entries"."amount_cents" AND "entries"."target_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."exchange_rate" IS NULL AND "entries"."exchange_quote_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("entries"."kind" = 'exchange' AND "entries"."target_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."target_account_id" <> "entries"."account_id" AND "entries"."target_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."target_currency" <> "entries"."currency" AND typeof("entries"."target_amount_minor") = 'integer' AND "entries"."target_amount_minor" > 0 AND "entries"."target_amount_minor" <= 1000000000000 AND "entries"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL)

exchange_rate_text.name: exchange_rate_text
exchange_rate_text.value: "entries"."exchange_rate" IS NULL OR (typeof("entries"."exchange_rate") = 'text' AND length("entries"."exchange_rate") BETWEEN 1 AND 21 AND "entries"."exchange_rate" GLOB '[0-9]*' AND "entries"."exchange_rate" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND length("entries"."exchange_rate") - length(replace("entries"."exchange_rate",'.','')) <= 1 AND "entries"."exchange_rate" NOT LIKE '%.' AND length(replace(replace("entries"."exchange_rate",'0',''),'.','')) > 0)

quote_rates.name: quote_rates
quote_rates.value: (typeof("exchange_quotes"."buy_rate") = 'text' AND length("exchange_quotes"."buy_rate") BETWEEN 1 AND 21 AND "exchange_quotes"."buy_rate" GLOB '[0-9]*' AND "exchange_quotes"."buy_rate" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND length("exchange_quotes"."buy_rate") - length(replace("exchange_quotes"."buy_rate",'.','')) <= 1 AND "exchange_quotes"."buy_rate" NOT LIKE '%.' AND length(replace(replace("exchange_quotes"."buy_rate",'0',''),'.','')) > 0) AND (typeof("exchange_quotes"."sell_rate") = 'text' AND length("exchange_quotes"."sell_rate") BETWEEN 1 AND 21 AND "exchange_quotes"."sell_rate" GLOB '[0-9]*' AND "exchange_quotes"."sell_rate" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND length("exchange_quotes"."sell_rate") - length(replace("exchange_quotes"."sell_rate",'.','')) <= 1 AND "exchange_quotes"."sell_rate" NOT LIKE '%.' AND length(replace(replace("exchange_quotes"."sell_rate",'0',''),'.','')) > 0)

quote_series_currency.name: quote_series_currency
quote_series_currency.value: (series = 'usd-oficial' AND currency = 'USD') OR (series = 'usd-mep' AND currency = 'USD') OR (series = 'usd-blue' AND currency = 'USD') OR (series = 'eur' AND currency = 'EUR') OR (series = 'brl' AND currency = 'BRL') OR (series = 'clp' AND currency = 'CLP') OR (series = 'uyu' AND currency = 'UYU')

breakdown_target.name: breakdown_target
breakdown_target.value: (entry_id IS NOT NULL AND history_row_id IS NULL) OR (entry_id IS NULL AND history_row_id IS NOT NULL)

statement_row_money.name: statement_row_money
statement_row_money.value: typeof(amount_minor)='integer' AND abs(amount_minor) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000 AND (kind='part' OR amount_minor>0)

statement_row_date.name: statement_row_date
statement_row_date.value: length(date)=10 AND date(date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(date,'+0 days')=date

statement_row_scope.name: statement_row_scope
statement_row_scope.value: (scope='ledger' AND kind IN ('income','expense') AND entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (scope='history' AND kind IN ('income','expense') AND entry_id IS NULL) OR (scope='internal' AND kind='internal' AND entry_id IS NULL) OR (scope='part' AND kind='part' AND entry_id IS NULL)

stock_company_chart.name: stock_company_chart
stock_company_chart.value: ("stock_companies"."exchange" IS NULL AND "stock_companies"."tradingview_symbol" IS NULL) OR ("stock_companies"."exchange" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_companies"."tradingview_symbol" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_companies"."tradingview_symbol" = "stock_companies"."exchange" || ':' || "stock_companies"."symbol")
